paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Petura. Tosefta Gittin, chapter 2: one who tears marks in hide in the shape of writing produces an invalid document; one who marks the hide in the shape of writing produces a valid one. R. Yosi HaGelili says: just as a scroll is specifically something without the breath of life, etc. R. Yehudah ben Petura says: just as a scroll is specifically detached, this excludes something attached.
